name: faq-accordion
delta: Radix-style accordion. Clicking a question toggles data-state closed<->open and aria-expanded false<->true on the trigger; the associated [role=region] panel goes hidden->visible, animating height 0->auto (animate-accordion-down) and the chevron icon rotates 0->180deg. Each item toggles independently.

name: theme-toggle
delta: Toggles the `light`/`dark` class on <html> (default `light`, captured htmlClass: '__variable_f367f3 scroll-smooth light'). Cream hero bg, cyan bands, yellow button, and gray body text swap to a dark palette. Source uses next-themes; clone reproduces with a class toggle + persisted localStorage and CSS variables.

name: button-link-hover
delta: Primary yellow button (#fbd950) and cyan buttons shift on hover (transition-colors ~150ms). Nav links change color on hover. Outline 'Learn More' button gets a subtle bg tint. All CSS transition-based, no JS.

name: entrance-on-load
delta: Hero content + badge fade/translate in on initial load (framer-motion style). Reproduced with CSS keyframes + IntersectionObserver reveal for below-the-fold sections.
